reason: A lot of that free work is me choosing to keep long-standing clients happy, so a report listing it doesn't change much, because I'm not going to start sending invoices for every small favour. On top of that, pulling exports out of ConnectWise and QuickBooks and digging out contract PDFs is an afternoon I don't have, so even the free audit would probably just sit on my list.
objection: Even if it finds real money, getting it back means awkward conversations with clients I've had for years. I'd rather absorb some leakage than risk the relationship, and uploads only with no ConnectWise integration makes it more hassle than it's worth.
would_change_my_mind: A direct ConnectWise and QuickBooks integration, so it runs without me exporting anything, plus help with the client conversation, like ready-made wording for a contract review or renewal uplift so it doesn't feel like chasing old money.
